net.note: rollback netcode: input delay (frames), its ceiling, the deepest rollback, the state-hash interval (frames), how many past intents each packet repeats, how many round trips the delay estimate keeps

playable.note: a link is playable when it stalls no more than this per minute (its delay and rollback ceilings are the net row's)

ping.note: the delay handshake: a ping every N frames, the round trips it takes, the frame cap, and how often hello repeats before the fight starts

silence.note: a quiet peer: the wait before the fight shows it, the time it may rejoin, the time before it counts as having left

reconnect.note: the duel link's reconnect timing (ms): first retry, the backoff cap in the fast window and after it, how long it keeps trying, when a heartbeat counts as stale, when a quiet direct path is also sent over the relay

messageCaps.note: characters: a whole duel message, and one packet's intent columns (64 intents are about 560)

duelAntifarm.note: PLACEHOLDERS (Stats): starting rating, K factor, lowest rating; base pay of a counted win, how many a day pay in full, the multiplier after each further win and its floor; the day is the UTC day
